messages:
Sam K: Starting Ceres Labs POC perf run in ~15m. Plan: smoke -> 250 qps sustained (20m) -> two 3m spikes to 1000 qps. Customer target p99 < 200ms. @Noah M confirm Dedicated capacity?
Priya V: Dedicated available (6xA10). Sustained 250 qps ~70% reserved; spikes will hit shared burst unless reserved. Estimate spike window compute +22%.
Sam K: We'll test 8-bit quantized path (cost match) and fp16 baseline. Note quantization can add jitter.
Noah M: Default batching coalesce=8ms. Recommend run default then coalesce=16ms for tail improvement.
SalesAssistBot: Ceres asks for deterministic fallback rather than degraded-model fallback. Possible?
Noah M: We can't queue indefinitely on shared burst. Options: reserve burst capacity or fall back to smaller model (quality change). Need customer signoff for fallback.
DeployBot: Job scheduled id=ceres-2351009999-run1.
Sam K: k6 snippet:
# k6 pseudo
k6 run --vus 250 --duration 20m -e ENDPOINT=https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat -e TOKEN=$POC_KEY script.js

[~90m later]
Sam K: Baseline quantized sustained 250 qps: avg 95ms p95 150ms p99 340ms. Spike -> avg 410ms p95 760ms p99 1.2s. fp16 baseline p99 290ms.
Priya V: p99s breach their requirement. Traces show batching wait increases during spikes and CPU steal on one host.
Sam K: Action: 1) rerun fp16 with coalesce=16ms, 2) rerun quantized with prefix cache primed, 3) gather per-host kernel metrics.
Noah M: Simulation: coalesce=16ms reduces p99 ~40% but raises p50 slightly. Recommend proposing coalesce change plus burst reservation option.
Priya V: Security asks: KMS envelope encryption yes, audit log export to their S3 possible. They requested 7yr retention and proof of per-tenant cache isolation for POC; infra validated ephemeral isolation for this run. EU-data residency flagged as potential blocker for hosted POC.
SalesAssistBot: Sales will produce two quotes: (A) Reserved Dedicated + perf tuning, (B) Reserved Dedicated + burst reservation + SLA/credits. Include non-degradation clause if fallback used.
Sam K: Uploaded artifacts to drive/ceres/poc/perf-2351009999-summary.csv and perf-hists-2351009999.png. CSV cols: phase,qps,avg_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,batching_wait_ms,host_cpu_steal_pct.
Noah M: I'll run kernel-level tracing on the slow host during the next spike and estimate cost uplift for burst reservation.
Priya V: I'll attach KMS/audit answers and note legal for EU-data residency.
Sam K: Thanks team. We'll retest tomorrow and send a concise customer-facing summary contrasting quantized vs fp16 tradeoffs and cost impacts. :rocket:
